nodes.description: External, unauthenticated function that builds a nominateNewOwner payload and performs a low-level call on any caller-supplied contract address.
BaseMigration constructor which records deployer = msg.sender and sets the owner.
Accepts ownership, requiring msg.sender to equal nominatedOwner, then transfers owner and clears nominatedOwner.
Owner-only setter for the nominatedOwner state variable.
Deployer-only migration that accepts ownership of many contracts, imports addresses, rebuilds caches and performs privileged setters on external contracts.
Public function that resolves and caches required addresses, writing to the private addressCache mapping.
Owner-only function that writes arbitrary name to address mappings into the repository.
Payable fallback that records msg.sender on the target and forwards arbitrary calldata and value via a low-level call.
ERC20 transfer implementation that sets messageSender on the target and forwards the call.
Withdraws vested SNX for msg.sender by iterating the vesting schedule, updating balances and transferring tokens.
Internal escrow append using block.timestamp based vesting time and SafeMath balance accounting.
Authority-gated distribution that transfers SNX to configured destinations and performs low-level notifyRewardAmount calls to arbitrary contracts.
Suspends the system after checking the caller against the access control mapping.
Writes balances of an arbitrary account, gated only by msg.sender == associatedContract.
Owner address used by onlyOwner checks and the migration ownership handover.
Pending owner address set by nomination and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Address allowed to invoke onlyDeployer functions, set to the deploying msg.sender.
Caller identity forwarded through the proxy, writable by onlyProxy.
Address authorised to call distributeRewards.
Total escrowed SNX tracked against the contract token balance.
msg.sender as consumed by ownership, authorisation and beneficiary checks across the contracts.
block.timestamp (now) used to derive vesting times and to test vesting eligibility.
Low-level call in returnOwnership to an arbitrary forContract address, with a fallback legacy call path, invoked by any caller.
Low-level call with abi.encodeWithSignature("notifyRewardAmount(uint256)", ...) to each distribution destination whose success/failure is ignored.
Assembly call forwarding calldata and callvalue to the target via sload(target_slot), returning unchecked returndata.
Unchecked arithmetic uint time = now + 52 weeks in _appendVestingEntry.
IERC20(synthetix).transfer(msg.sender, total) external token transfer performed during vest.
Caller-supplied contract address that receives the ownership nomination low-level call.
Expected current owner address validated against owner before migration proceeds.
Total SNX amount to distribute to configured destinations and escrow remainder.
Account for which a new vesting entry is appended.
Quantity of SNX to escrow for the account.
ABI-encoded calldata (nominateNewOwner or legacy nominateOwner) used for the low-level call.
Running remainder of the distribution amount that flows into the notifyRewardAmount calls.
Accumulator of vested quantities in the vest loop.
Local vesting timestamp computed as now + 52 weeks.

edges.reason: returnOwnership is external with no sender authentication, so any msg.sender can trigger an ownership nomination call.
returnOwnership executes a low-level call to a caller-supplied contract, allowing reentrancy or malicious fallback behaviour during the ownership handover.
The low-level call target address is the caller-controlled forContract parameter.
The ABI-encoded payload local becomes the calldata of the low-level call.
returnOwnership constructs the abi.encodeWithSignature payload used for the call.
The constructor stores msg.sender into the deployer state variable, permanently granting onlyDeployer rights.
The BaseMigration constructor reads msg.sender to initialise deployer.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal nominatedOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership writes the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership updates nominatedOwner and clears it after the handover.
nominateNewOwner writes the nominatedOwner state variable, a stepping stone to full ownership.
migrate requires the passed currentOwner to match owner before performing privileged operations.
migrate (onlyDeployer) invokes importAddresses on the AddressResolver, which is itself onlyOwner.
migrate triggers rebuildCaches on dozens of MixinResolver contracts to refresh their caches.
rebuildCache writes resolved destinations into the addressCache storage.
The proxy fallback forwards arbitrary calldata and msg.value to the target through a low-level call.
The fallback writes the untrusted msg.sender into messageSender on the target before forwarding the call.
The fallback calls target.setMessageSender(msg.sender), making the untrusted caller the effective sender for proxy-gated logic.
ProxyERC20.transfer calls target.setMessageSender(msg.sender) before forwarding the ERC20 call.
ERC20 entry points are executed through the Proxy fallback and its low-level forwarding.
vest is externally callable by any msg.sender and both reads and updates msg.sender scoped balances.
vest performs an external ERC20 transfer of vested SNX to msg.sender during state mutation.
Vesting eligibility in vest is decided by comparing block.timestamp against stored vesting times.
The vest loop accumulates each vested quantity into the total local variable.
vest subtracts the withdrawn total from the totalEscrowedBalance state variable.
_appendVestingEntry computes time = now + 52 weeks with unchecked arithmetic.
The appended vesting time derives directly from block.timestamp, making the schedule timestamp dependent.
The quantity parameter is validated and added to escrow totals inside _appendVestingEntry.
The account parameter selects which vesting schedule mapping is appended to.
_appendVestingEntry increases totalEscrowedBalance by the appended quantity.
_appendVestingEntry stores the computed time local into the vesting schedule entry.
distributeRewards enforces msg.sender == authority before releasing funds.
distributeRewards issues low-level notifyRewardAmount calls to each configured destination, ignoring failures and opening reentrancy paths during external transfers.
The amount parameter bounds the total rewards transferred and must be backed by the contract balance.
The per-destination remainder value is encoded into the notifyRewardAmount low-level call data.
distributeRewards successively subtracts each distribution amount from the remainder local.
The authority state variable gates who may invoke distributeRewards, and it is owner-settable.
suspendSystem authorises the caller through accessControl[section][msg.sender].canSuspend.
setBalanceOf is gated only by msg.sender == associatedContract, a single mutable address.

normalization_plan.reason: forContract is a parameter of returnOwnership and should be merged into the calling function context that feeds the unsafe low-level call.
currentOwner is a parameter of Migration_Alnitak.migrate used solely for the ownership equality check.
amount is the distribution parameter of distributeRewards and should be merged into that core function.
account is the vesting beneficiary parameter of appendVestingEntry, merged into the core escrow function.
quantity is the vesting amount parameter of appendVestingEntry and belongs to the same core function.
payload is a local variable in returnOwnership produced for and consumed by the unsafe low-level call.
remainder is a local whose value flows into the unsafe notifyRewardAmount low-level call.
total is a loop accumulator local inside the core vest function.
time is the local result of the unchecked arithmetic now + 52 weeks operation in _appendVestingEntry.
